schema.rows[].real_model: model string of the real driver this row stands in for, or "*" for the catch-all row
schema.rows[].api: the Viam API both the real model and the sim model serve, or "*" on the catch-all row, which matches any hardware API with no row
schema.rows[].sim_model: the sim model constructed in the real one's place; rdk:builtin:fake on the catch-all row, a placeholder generic component
schema.rows[].template: attributes of the swapped resource; the resolver adds world_attribute set to the simulator field's value; a string value starting with "$" copies that field of the real resource's config ("$frame.parent" is the frame parent's name)
schema.rows[].carry: map from an attribute name on the real resource to the sim attribute it becomes; the resolver copies the value unchanged when the real entry has it and skips it otherwise; {} when nothing carries
schema.rows[].verified: true when real_model was read from the real module's manifest, README or the Viam docs on the date in rows[].source; false when it follows the module's naming pattern but was not found in its published model list
schema.rows[].source: where real_model was read, and when
schema.rows[].note: optional, anything the resolver or a reader should know about the row

rows.note: the sim gripper needs the arm it is bolted to; the real entry carries that only as its frame parent, so the template copies it from there
a jetbot is a wheeled base over two motors; the motors have no sim row and are left as they are, so a machine-level swap of a jetbot still needs them removed or faked

the frame is carried over unchanged and places the sim camera; width_px and height_px carry to the sim camera's width and height; a depth stream requested through the sensors list becomes depth: true by a resolver rule, since that is a transform, not a copy

any hardware component with no row becomes a placeholder generic component (api rdk:component:generic, model rdk:builtin:fake) with its name, frame and depends_on kept and no attributes, so the sim machine's config loads; the one row where api changes; allow_unmatched keeps the real entry instead
